summary: Reindex the second sum by τ ↦ (−p)·τ: l((−p)τ) = l̄(τ), and w_j is unchanged (neither place is thick).

steps.claim: Split the difference of sums and reindex the second by the bijection τ ↦ (−p)·τ.
Termwise: l((−p)·τ) = l̄(τ) (`inducedPlace_neg_pow_mul_of_odd`, e = 1) and w_j((−p)τ) = w_j(τ) since both places are non-thick when their prime is in Λ (`notMem_thick`).
